# MCP Development References

Use the official MCP Python SDK v2 documentation at <https://py.sdk.modelcontextprotocol.io/> and the protocol documentation at <https://modelcontextprotocol.io/> when changing the MCP server.

Use the Azure Functions Python developer reference at <https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-functions/functions-reference-python> when changing the Function App entry point or host configuration.
